sections.heading: Section 4: Firsthand Failure Modes, Traps & Economics Checks
paragraphs: Proof is the first leak. In the Callvane demo, the host walks through a buyer showing 50 calls against only 40 recordings, the exact mismatch that turns a pay-per-call invoice into an argument [Bu_9XhXpDSs @ 00:11:08]. Duration rules decide what bills: in the network example Hartley & Sons pays $100 for calls that reach 120 seconds, and a 47-second call is flagged as not billable [Bu_9XhXpDSs @ 01:03:07]. Callvane supports disputes, but the cleaner play is setting the qualifier per buyer up front, such as 90 seconds at $40. On the lead side, boberdoo.com returns a response on every single post so sellers know exactly what happened to each lead, which they say reduces discrepancies [DSbDVWpyXUI @ 00:05:27]. Refunds are the next drain. boberdoo says its roughly 150 clients handle refunds about a hundred different ways, and the fix they built is a cap, for example refunds capped at 15% over the past 30 days, with CSV bulk approval for the rest [yCAVYNpSdZI @ 00:22:50]. Lead QC closes the front door: junk like 555-1212 gets held with an error returned, so you are not responsible to buy the lead. Every one of these is a billing fight you either automate away or eat by hand.

Integration breakage kills revenue silently. Lead Prosper warns that switching the payload type after editing resets the builder, so set form or JSON before touching a single field [gX0fjRlg1lg @ 00:01:33]. On LeadsPedia buyers, lp_test=1 goes in for testing and must come out before go-live, and the same rule applies to lp_action test on Lead Prosper's own buyer setup [_1N3fncM-Ss @ 00:00:21]. Phonexa posts carry their own trap: most fields are optional on the post, so you confirm with the buyer exactly which fields they need before sending live traffic [Pzlk50aGkUg @ 00:01:37]. Field names are case-sensitive, so copy and paste them instead of retyping. On the auction side, boberdoo.com built a max best price ceiling for one reason: a buyer who fat-fingers a $1,000 bid at a 10% margin would pass $900 back to the seller as the represented bid [DSbDVWpyXUI @ 00:17:44]. Slow buyers get cut by timeouts, such as 15 seconds on the ping and 30 on the post, so lagging buyers are excluded from the auction. boberdoo adds that a buyer not returning a bid typically has something wrong with its server, and dynamic buyers that return nothing get a $0 fallback price.

Unit economics punish anyone who skips the math. The Callvane host prices Ringba at a $150 monthly minimum plus per-number fees, then meters 5 cents a minute incoming, 3 cents outgoing and 1 cent recording, so a single three-minute call costs 27 cents [Bu_9XhXpDSs @ 00:15:53]. LeadSmart now demands a website before issuing numbers, unused numbers expire the next month, and Callvane's receive-only SMS numbers at $0.10 a month are not 10DLC-registered. boberdoo.com is equally blunt that its DNC list is internal only and not tied to state or federal lists [DSbDVWpyXUI @ 00:47:23]. Jason Grossman says 80% of GoHighLevel users are not getting results because it is not set up properly; it is a beast that needs one tech person to build it and a VA team to manage it, on top of the 97 USD monthly fee [Ot93upK_YX4 @ 00:35:44]. Scaling spend has its own trap. MoreMozi's client hit diminishing returns pushing more budget through Meta, so the advisor ran the math the other way: lift customer value from 3K to 10K or 12K and 3:1 becomes 12:1, and even if returns slide from 3:1 to 2:1, the 12:1 still lands at 9:1 [94mDeuLH24c @ 00:02:11]. The advisor's other warning is direct: don't turn off Meta, don't stop the flow.

callout.title: Four checks before any buyer, call or lead goes live
callout.body: Every one of these gates comes from a leak a practitioner hit or built a fix for. Run all four before routing paid traffic.
items: Do not bill or pay a call until it clears the buyer's duration qualifier; the 47-second call in the network example never bills [Local SEO Made Easy — Bu_9XhXpDSs @ 01:03:07].
Set a max best price ceiling on every dynamic buyer so a $1,000 typo bid cannot pass $900 back to a seller [boberdoo.com — DSbDVWpyXUI @ 00:17:44].
Strip lp_action test from the payload builder before go-live, then copy all to the buyer [Lead Prosper — gX0fjRlg1lg @ 00:05:22].
Cap buyer refunds, for example at 15% over the past 30 days, before the first invoice goes out [boberdoo.com — yCAVYNpSdZI @ 00:22:50].

chapters.pull_quote: 'Don't stay on just one limited network.' — Local SEO Made Easy (Bu_9XhXpDSs @ 00:41:13).
action_checklist: Strip every non-required field from the ping and send it with the Mode field on the same URL as the post [Lead Prosper — Ma1kH51odZ0 @ 00:00:23].
Set the payload type to form or JSON before editing any field, because switching later resets the builder [Lead Prosper — gX0fjRlg1lg @ 00:01:33].
Build each buyer's filter set with daily, weekly and monthly caps plus delivery schedules [boberdoo.com — Dktb23hf-d8 @ 00:00:42].
Use update default values so every new source is created as not active until you switch it on [boberdoo.com — SxFdDGaaQiM @ 00:00:38].
Build a ring tree across LeadSmart, Leads Magician and CallScaler instead of relying on one network [Local SEO Made Easy — Bu_9XhXpDSs @ 00:39:53].
Have voice AI call every new sign-up within 60 seconds, then layer manual VA calls and SMS behind it [Jason Grossman — Ot93upK_YX4 @ 00:52:38].
